title: Public and Free Miami Event Listings to Check
igCaption:
Karol G's public pop-up runs Oct. 2 and 3, 11 AM to 6 PM, at 555 NW 29th St.
Free-event listings exist for The Underline and Miami Beach Bandshell. The Bass has a Free Family Fun Day listing, and MOCA North Miami has a free and cheap events listing.
Which one should we check for exact dates and RSVP details next?

Sources: Secret Miami, South Florida on the Cheap

#MiamiEvents #FreeMiami #MiamiGuide #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: Need Miami events to check? Start with a public Karol G pop-up and free-event listings that already name the venues.

Karol G's Viajando Por El Mundo pop-up opens to the public October second and third, from eleven a.m. to six p.m. Find it at five five five Northwest twenty-ninth Street. Entry is first-come, first-served, and space is limited.
